rows: Equipment: Testing the earth leakage protection device on the main generator, 67G, tdg20b-eg2, Toshiba.
Procedure: Using a current and voltage injection set PHU-100.

items: Open the two switches of the circuit whose protection is to be tested, and open the circuit isolators.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.

rows: 2 V-A AC current measuring instruments, model YOKOGAWA.
2 current and voltage injection sets model PHU-100.
Set the change-over switch (43) type BH-H7 for testing protection (G 67) to Test.
Remove the front cover of the relay.
Clean the contact points using (spray CROWN-8276).
Clean the relay from dust using the air blower.
Open the protection cell from the back.
Disconnect voltage terminal No. 8 on relay (67G), keeping the terminal screw.
Connect the current injection leads to points (27, 28) in the test plug as shown in the illustration.
Connect the voltage injection leads to points (7, 8) on relay (67G) as shown in the figure.
Raise the current gradually until you can read the phase difference between voltage and current.
Set the angle to 60, voltage on Input and current on Reference.
Raise the current gradually until the signal drops on relay 67G.
Record the relay (67G) operating current value.
Set the injection current value to 10 times the setting value on the relay.
Increase the angle between voltage and current in the LAG direction using the angle control on the PHU-100 set until the relay signal drops, and record the LAG angle value using the dedicated switch.
Reverse the current direction by changing the phase angle by 180 using the dedicated angle switch on the PHU-100 set.
Increase the angle between voltage and current in the LEAD direction using the dedicated angle switch on the PHU-100 set until the relay signal drops, and record the angle value.
Remove test plug type HP2-C8 from the protection cell.
Replace the relay glass cover and fasten it.
Reset the lockout relay of relay 67G on the protection cell.
Set the change-over switch (43) type BH-H7 for testing protection 67G to NORMAL on the protection cell.

Introduction.
Safety Precautions.
Open the two switches of the circuit whose protection is to be tested, and open the circuit isolators.
Open a work permit.
Fence the work area.
Place the necessary warning signs.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Tools and Equipment Used.
2 transformers 200/400, 1 kVA, single phase. | 1.
1 three-phase switch. | 2.
Avometer (Fluky 87). | 3.
2 V-A AC current measuring instruments, model YOKOGAWA. | 4.
Test comb model HP2-C8. | 5.
Test Leads. | 6.
1 Digital Phase Meter (KDK DPF-30N). | 7.
Contact point cleaning tools (spray CROWN-8276). | 8.
2 current and voltage injection sets model PHU-100. | 9.
Procedures to be Carried Out.
Set the change-over switch (43) type BH-H7 for testing protection (G 67) to Test. | 1.
Remove the front cover of the relay. | 2.
Clean the contact points using (spray CROWN-8276). | 3.
Clean the relay from dust using the air blower. | 4.
Short points (11, 13, 15, 17), (15, 16), (13, 14), (11, 12), (17, 18) on test plug type HP2-C8. | 5.
Insert test plug type HP2-C8. | 6.
Open the protection cell from the back. | 7.
Disconnect voltage terminal No. 8 on relay (67G), keeping the terminal screw. | 8.
Connect the current injection leads to points (27, 28) in the test plug as shown in the illustration. | 9.
Connect the voltage injection leads to points (7, 8) on relay (67G) as shown in the figure. | 10.
Inject voltage at 110 V. | 11.
Raise the current gradually until you can read the phase difference between voltage and current. | 12.
Set the angle to 60, voltage on Input and current on Reference. | 13.
Raise the current gradually until the signal drops on relay 67G. | 14.
Record the relay (67G) operating current value. | 15.
Set the injection current value to 10 times the setting value on the relay. | 16.
Increase the angle between voltage and current in the LAG direction using the angle control on the PHU-100 set until the relay signal drops, and record the LAG angle value using the dedicated switch. | 17.
Reverse the current direction by changing the phase angle by 180 using the dedicated angle switch on the PHU-100 set. | 18.
Increase the angle between voltage and current in the LEAD direction using the dedicated angle switch on the PHU-100 set until the relay signal drops, and record the angle value. | 19.
Reconnect terminal No. (8) to relay 67G. | 20.
Reset relay 67G. | 21.
Remove test plug type HP2-C8 from the protection cell. | 22.
Replace the relay glass cover and fasten it. | 23.
Reset the lockout relay of relay 67G on the protection cell. | 24.
Set the change-over switch (43) type BH-H7 for testing protection 67G to NORMAL on the protection cell. | 25.
